title: Buffer path can corrupt a split UTF-8 code point
description: index.js decodes each Buffer chunk with toString('utf8'); a multibyte code point split across chunks becomes U+FFFD when the chunk is rewritten.
acceptance_criteria: Property: wrapper over Buffer chunks preserves arbitrary UTF-8 bytes under any split.
close_reason: red bfea92d -> fix d55640e. npm test pass 13 fail 0; P-09 seed=1699929052 n=100 pass.

title: Split paste-end marker leaves inPaste stuck
description: If \x1b[201~ is split across reads, inPaste stays true and the plugin silently stops translating for the rest of the session.
acceptance_criteria: Property: after a paste ends (any split), Option sequences are translated again.
close_reason: red 4303780 -> fix ed6ed34. npm test green (pass 11); NUM_RUNS=20000 FC_SEED=1,2,3 node --test test/translate.property.test.js all pass.

title: Split paste-start marker lets pasted text be rewritten
description: If \x1b[200~ is split across reads, the translator does not enter paste mode and rewrites Option-like bytes inside the paste.
acceptance_criteria: Property: bytes inside bracketed paste are byte-identical regardless of chunking.
close_reason: red 65fb091 -> fix ed6ed34. npm test green (pass 11); NUM_RUNS=20000 FC_SEED=1,2,3 node --test test/translate.property.test.js all pass.

title: ESC and DEL split across reads pass through untranslated
description: translate() is not chunk-boundary safe: an Option sequence split across read() chunks (e.g. ESC | DEL) is not rewritten; audit saw 245/20000 random splits diverge.
acceptance_criteria: Property: for any input and any split, concatenated output equals single-chunk output.
close_reason: red d39a732 -> fix ed6ed34. npm test green (pass 11); NUM_RUNS=20000 FC_SEED=1,2,3 node --test test/translate.property.test.js all pass.
